# Fault codes

Every failure the daemon reports carries one of these codes and a remedy.
They appear in the `Fault` D-Bus signal, in the logs as `code=`, and in
`dictator stats` counters. The codes are stable; the messages are not.

| Code | Area |
|---|---|
| `platform.no_session` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.no_shortcut_backend` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.no_injection_backend` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.shortcut_taken` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.shortcut_bind_failed` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.portal_unavailable` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.portal_denied` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `platform.injection_failed` | Display server, shortcuts, injection |
| `audio.no_device` | Capture devices and streams |
| `audio.device_lost` | Capture devices and streams |
| `audio.device_busy` | Capture devices and streams |
| `audio.stream_failed` | Capture devices and streams |
| `asr.model_not_found` | Speech model loading and decoding |
| `asr.model_load_failed` | Speech model loading and decoding |
| `asr.model_digest_mismatch` | Speech model loading and decoding |
| `asr.model_download_failed` | Speech model loading and decoding |
| `asr.decode_failed` | Speech model loading and decoding |
| `memory.store_unavailable` | Transcript store |
| `memory.store_corrupt` | Transcript store |
| `config.invalid` | Configuration files |
| `config.unwritable` | Configuration files |
| `session.busy` | Dictation lifecycle |
| `session.not_recording` | Dictation lifecycle |
| `internal` | Unclassified — report these |
